faq.q: Where can I make TikTok videos that have a chance to travel?
faq.a: Use a tool that builds TikTok-style video from your product, with a script and a voice, so you can test often. That is what this page does. No tool can promise a video will take off.

faq.q: Can the frames carry our logo and colors?
faq.a: Yes. The frames can follow your product and your brand, which is what you want before the ad goes into the account.

faq.q: What has to happen before the AI TikTok ad exists?
faq.a: Paste the product page or write one line about the product. You hear a voice and see the tall frame when the render ends. For the opening seconds, see [how to make a TikTok ad](/guides/first-tiktok-video-ad).

faq.q: How does a product page become a TikTok video?
faq.a: The page already has the photos and the facts. You pick an AI avatar, the spoken line uses those facts, and captions sit on the clip. You post it yourself.

faq.q: What does this TikTok ad maker do?
faq.a: It turns a product page into an AI TikTok ad with an [AI actor](/ai-video-generation/ai-actors). You can rewrite the line before you download.

faq.q: Should I expect this to beat a filmed ad?
faq.a: Only your TikTok account can say that. What you gain here is several openings to compare before a shoot could be scheduled. We do not promise a higher return.

faq.q: What do sellers gain from AI on TikTok?
faq.a: You can refresh the campaign when the first opening goes quiet, and the next file does not start with an influencer invoice.

faq.q: Will this choose my TikTok audience?
faq.a: No. TikTok is where you pick who sees it. Here you can make a softer line and a blunter line, then run each one on the audience you already defined.

faq.q: Can I match the ad to my brand?
faq.a: Yes. The clip can use your colors, and the voice can say the line the way your captions do.
